state.paragraph: On October 12, 2013, CSC, Pamplona and Mac-Gray executed a letter agreement extending exclusivity until 11:59 p.m. ET on October 15, 2013.

ledger_rows.Note: Letter agreement extended exclusivity to 11:59 p.m. ET 10/15/2013 after CSC/Pamplona agreed to an $11M Mac-Gray termination fee.

deadline.instructions: `paragraph` reports that the target or its banker sets, changes or communicates a bid deadline, process letter or request for final offers. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.

exclusivity.instructions: `paragraph` reports that exclusivity is requested, authorised, granted, signed or extended. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
